related_work: The first thing I did in relation to my project was to create a layer-list, a hierarchy of what parts I want to appear where in my animation. Following this, I created a detailed list of research topics that would be relevant for the manufacturing of electronic devices, such as the one I am focusing on.
title: London Field Trip, Planning Out, Console Design and Layers, Research
introduction: For this week, there was a bit of focus on the London field trip we would be going on, but the main thing for me was planning out the console that I would 'dissect', putting that into layers and doing research.
